row.team_price_text: Litera Compare Desktop: annual per-licence subscription (price not shown; store limited to 10 seats)
row.evidence: Workshare has been folded into Litera: Workshare Connect was discontinued on January 12, 2024, Workshare Transact has been discontinued, and Workshare Professional contracts now renew as Litera Compare, a Windows desktop app sold as annual licences with license keys.
row.notes: Workshare's cloud products (Workshare Connect, Workshare Transact) are end-of-life, and the surviving product, Workshare Professional/Compare, is now Litera Compare Desktop, a Windows application licensed per seat with license keys. No SCIM, SAML or user-management API is documented on litera.com. Litera's support portal (support.litera.com) is a JavaScript app that could not be searched, so SCIM cannot be ruled out under the none-by-absence rule. The status stays unknown and may be better treated as not applicable (desktop software) or dropped at merge.

limitations.text: Workshare's SaaS products are discontinued: Workshare Connect (January 12, 2024) and Workshare Transact (users moved to Litera Transact).
The surviving product is Litera Compare Desktop, Windows-only software delivered with license keys.

fallbacks.notes: Workshare support now routes to Litera's customer portal, which needs JavaScript or login; no public provisioning docs were found.
